# Codex SDK v0.16.1 - Table of Contents

Idiomatic Elixir SDK for OpenAI's Codex agent. Provides a complete, production-ready
interface with streaming support, comprehensive event handling, and robust testing utilities.

## Modules

- [Codex.Agent](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Agent.md): Defines a reusable agent with instructions, tools, and hooks.

- [Codex.AgentRunner](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.AgentRunner.md): Multi-turn runner that orchestrates agent execution over Codex threads.

- [Codex.AppServer.Mcp](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.AppServer.Mcp.md): MCP (Model Context Protocol) server management for app-server connections.
- [Codex.AppServer.V1](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.AppServer.V1.md): Legacy v1 app-server endpoints for compatibility with older servers.

- [Codex.Auth](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Auth.md): API key resolution with `CODEX_API_KEY` → `auth.json` → `OPENAI_API_KEY` precedence.

- [Codex.Events.AccountLoginCompleted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.AccountLoginCompleted.md): Event emitted when account login completes.

- [Codex.Events.AccountRateLimitsUpdated](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.AccountRateLimitsUpdated.md): Event emitted when account rate limits are updated.
- [Codex.Events.AccountUpdated](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.AccountUpdated.md): Event emitted when account authentication state changes.

- [Codex.Events.AppListUpdated](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.AppListUpdated.md): Event emitted when the app catalog changes.

- [Codex.Events.AppServerNotification](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.AppServerNotification.md): Lossless wrapper for an app-server notification that is not yet mapped into a typed event.

- [Codex.Events.ChatgptAuthTokensRefreshRequested](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ChatgptAuthTokensRefreshRequested.md): Event emitted when the app-server asks the client to refresh ChatGPT auth tokens.

- [Codex.Events.CollabAgentInteractionBegin](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.CollabAgentInteractionBegin.md): Collab event emitted when an agent interaction starts.

- [Codex.Events.CollabAgentInteractionEnd](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.CollabAgentInteractionEnd.md): Collab event emitted when an agent interaction completes.

- [Codex.Events.CollabAgentSpawnBegin](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.CollabAgentSpawnBegin.md): Collab event emitted when an agent spawn starts.

- [Codex.Events.CollabAgentSpawnEnd](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.CollabAgentSpawnEnd.md): Collab event emitted when an agent spawn completes.

- [Codex.Events.CollabCloseBegin](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.CollabCloseBegin.md): Collab event emitted when a collab session begins closing.

- [Codex.Events.CollabCloseEnd](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.CollabCloseEnd.md): Collab event emitted when a collab session closes.

- [Codex.Events.CollabResumeBegin](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.CollabResumeBegin.md): Collab event emitted when an agent resume begins.

- [Codex.Events.CollabResumeEnd](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.CollabResumeEnd.md): Collab event emitted when an agent resume completes.

- [Codex.Events.CollabWaitingBegin](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.CollabWaitingBegin.md): Collab event emitted when an agent begins waiting.

- [Codex.Events.CollabWaitingEnd](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.CollabWaitingEnd.md): Collab event emitted when an agent stops waiting.

- [Codex.Events.CommandApprovalRequested](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.CommandApprovalRequested.md): Event emitted when the app-server requests approval for a command execution.

- [Codex.Events.CommandOutputDelta](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.CommandOutputDelta.md): Event delta emitted while a command execution is producing output.

- [Codex.Events.ConfigWarning](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ConfigWarning.md): Event emitted when configuration warnings are reported.

- [Codex.Events.ContextCompacted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ContextCompacted.md): Indicates that the conversation context was compacted.

- [Codex.Events.DeprecationNotice](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.DeprecationNotice.md): Event emitted when the server reports a deprecated feature or behavior.

- [Codex.Events.DynamicToolCallRequested](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.DynamicToolCallRequested.md): Event emitted when the app-server asks the client to execute a dynamic tool call.

- [Codex.Events.ElicitationRequest](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ElicitationRequest.md): Event emitted for MCP elicitation requests.

- [Codex.Events.EnteredReviewMode](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.EnteredReviewMode.md): Event emitted when a review session starts.

- [Codex.Events.Error](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.Error.md): General error event emitted by the CLI.

- [Codex.Events.ExitedReviewMode](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ExitedReviewMode.md): Event emitted when a review session ends.

- [Codex.Events.FileApprovalRequested](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.FileApprovalRequested.md): Event emitted when the app-server requests approval for a file change.

- [Codex.Events.FileChangeOutputDelta](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.FileChangeOutputDelta.md): Event delta emitted while a file change stream is producing output.

- [Codex.Events.FuzzyFileSearchSessionCompleted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.FuzzyFileSearchSessionCompleted.md): Event emitted when a fuzzy file search session finishes.

- [Codex.Events.FuzzyFileSearchSessionUpdated](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.FuzzyFileSearchSessionUpdated.md): Event emitted when a fuzzy file search session publishes updated matches.

- [Codex.Events.GuardianApprovalReview](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.GuardianApprovalReview.md): Review payload emitted by guardian auto-approval review notifications.

- [Codex.Events.GuardianApprovalReviewCompleted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.GuardianApprovalReviewCompleted.md): Event emitted when guardian review completes for an approval request.

- [Codex.Events.GuardianApprovalReviewStarted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.GuardianApprovalReviewStarted.md): Event emitted when guardian review begins for an approval request.

- [Codex.Events.HookCompleted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.HookCompleted.md): Event emitted when an app-server hook run completes.

- [Codex.Events.HookStarted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.HookStarted.md): Event emitted when an app-server hook run starts.

- [Codex.Events.ItemAgentMessageDelta](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ItemAgentMessageDelta.md): Event delta emitted when the agent produces message content.

- [Codex.Events.ItemCompleted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ItemCompleted.md): Event emitted when an item completes.

- [Codex.Events.ItemInputTextDelta](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ItemInputTextDelta.md): Event delta emitted for user input text items.

- [Codex.Events.ItemStarted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ItemStarted.md): Event emitted when an item begins processing.

- [Codex.Events.ItemUpdated](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ItemUpdated.md): Event emitted when an in-progress item receives an update.

- [Codex.Events.McpElicitationRequested](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.McpElicitationRequested.md): Event emitted when the app-server requests an MCP elicitation response from the client.

- [Codex.Events.McpServerOauthLoginCompleted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.McpServerOauthLoginCompleted.md): Event emitted when an MCP server OAuth login completes.

- [Codex.Events.McpServerStartupStatusUpdated](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.McpServerStartupStatusUpdated.md): Event emitted when app-server observes an MCP server startup state transition.

- [Codex.Events.McpStartupComplete](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.McpStartupComplete.md): Summary of MCP server startup completion.

- [Codex.Events.McpStartupUpdate](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.McpStartupUpdate.md): Incremental status update for MCP server startup.

- [Codex.Events.McpToolCallProgress](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.McpToolCallProgress.md): Progress message emitted while an MCP tool call is running.

- [Codex.Events.ModelRerouted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ModelRerouted.md): Event emitted when Codex reroutes a turn to a different model.

- [Codex.Events.PermissionsApprovalRequested](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.PermissionsApprovalRequested.md): Event emitted when the app-server requests additional permissions from the client.

- [Codex.Events.RawResponseItemCompleted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.RawResponseItemCompleted.md): Event emitted when a raw response item completes on the app-server stream.

- [Codex.Events.ReasoningDelta](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ReasoningDelta.md): Event delta emitted while reasoning content is streaming.

- [Codex.Events.ReasoningSummaryDelta](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ReasoningSummaryDelta.md): Event delta emitted while reasoning summary text is streaming.

- [Codex.Events.ReasoningSummaryPartAdded](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ReasoningSummaryPartAdded.md): Event emitted when a new reasoning summary part is added.

- [Codex.Events.RequestUserInput](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.RequestUserInput.md): Event emitted when the agent requests user input.

- [Codex.Events.ServerRequestResolved](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ServerRequestResolved.md): Event emitted when the app-server resolves a prior server request.

- [Codex.Events.SessionConfigured](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.SessionConfigured.md): Event emitted when a session is configured.

- [Codex.Events.ShutdownComplete](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ShutdownComplete.md): Event emitted when the agent shuts down.

- [Codex.Events.SkillsChanged](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.SkillsChanged.md): Invalidation signal emitted when watched skill metadata changes.

- [Codex.Events.TerminalInteraction](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.TerminalInteraction.md): Event emitted when stdin is written to an interactive command execution.

- [Codex.Events.ThreadArchived](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ThreadArchived.md): Event emitted when a thread is archived.

- [Codex.Events.ThreadNameUpdated](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ThreadNameUpdated.md): Event emitted when the thread display name changes.

- [Codex.Events.ThreadRealtimeClosed](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ThreadRealtimeClosed.md): Event emitted when thread realtime closes.

- [Codex.Events.ThreadRealtimeError](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ThreadRealtimeError.md): Event emitted when thread realtime encounters an error.

- [Codex.Events.ThreadRealtimeItemAdded](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ThreadRealtimeItemAdded.md): Event emitted when thread realtime adds a non-audio item.

- [Codex.Events.ThreadRealtimeOutputAudioDelta](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ThreadRealtimeOutputAudioDelta.md): Event emitted when thread realtime streams output audio.

- [Codex.Events.ThreadRealtimeStarted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ThreadRealtimeStarted.md): Event emitted when thread realtime startup is accepted.

- [Codex.Events.ThreadRolledBack](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ThreadRolledBack.md): Indicates that recent user turns were removed from context.

- [Codex.Events.ThreadStarted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ThreadStarted.md): Event emitted when a thread is first created.

- [Codex.Events.ThreadStatusChanged](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ThreadStatusChanged.md): Event emitted when thread load or activity status changes.

- [Codex.Events.ThreadTokenUsageUpdated](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ThreadTokenUsageUpdated.md): Incremental token usage update emitted while a turn is in flight.

- [Codex.Events.ThreadUnarchived](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ThreadUnarchived.md): Event emitted when a thread is restored from the archive.

- [Codex.Events.ToolCallCompleted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ToolCallCompleted.md): Event emitted when a tool call has completed and returned output.

- [Codex.Events.ToolCallRequested](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.ToolCallRequested.md): Indicates Codex requires a tool invocation to continue auto-run.

- [Codex.Events.TurnAborted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.TurnAborted.md): Event emitted when a turn is aborted.

- [Codex.Events.TurnCompaction](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.TurnCompaction.md): Signals that Codex compacted a turn's history.

- [Codex.Events.TurnCompleted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.TurnCompleted.md): Final event for a turn, optionally carrying final response and usage data.

- [Codex.Events.TurnContinuation](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.TurnContinuation.md): Signals that a continuation token is available for resuming the turn.

- [Codex.Events.TurnDiffUpdated](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.TurnDiffUpdated.md): Event emitted when the app-server publishes a turn diff update.

- [Codex.Events.TurnFailed](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.TurnFailed.md): Event emitted when a turn fails.

- [Codex.Events.TurnPlanUpdated](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.TurnPlanUpdated.md): Event emitted when the app-server publishes an updated plan for the current turn.

- [Codex.Events.TurnStarted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.TurnStarted.md): Event emitted when a new turn starts.

- [Codex.Events.UndoCompleted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.UndoCompleted.md): Event emitted when an undo operation completes.

- [Codex.Events.UndoStarted](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.UndoStarted.md): Event emitted when an undo operation begins.

- [Codex.Events.Warning](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.Warning.md): Warning event emitted during a turn.

- [Codex.Events.WindowsWorldWritableWarning](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Events.WindowsWorldWritableWarning.md): Event emitted when world-writable Windows paths are detected.

- [Codex.FileSearch](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.FileSearch.md): Configuration for file search capabilities in threads and runs.
- [Codex.Files.Attachment](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Files.Attachment.md): Represents a staged file attachment.

- [Codex.FunctionTool](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.FunctionTool.md): Convenience macro for defining function-backed tools with JSON schemas.
- [Codex.Guardrail](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Guardrail.md): Represents an input or output guardrail invoked around agent execution.

- [Codex.HTTPClient](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.HTTPClient.md): HTTP client abstraction for making HTTP requests.
- [Codex.HTTPClient.Mock](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.HTTPClient.Mock.md): Mock HTTP client for testing.
- [Codex.HTTPClient.Req](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.HTTPClient.Req.md): HTTP client implementation using Req.
- [Codex.Handoff](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Handoff.md): Represents a handoff from one agent to another, wrapping the downstream agent as a tool with
optional input filtering and history nesting controls.

- [Codex.Handoff.InputData](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Handoff.InputData.md): Carries conversation history and run context into handoff input filters.

- [Codex.IO.Buffer](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.IO.Buffer.md): Shared helpers for newline-delimited subprocess output buffering and JSON decoding.

- [Codex.Items.AgentMessage](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.AgentMessage.md): Assistant-authored message item emitted by the Codex runtime, with optional parsed
payloads for structured output experiments.

- [Codex.Items.CollabAgentToolCall](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.CollabAgentToolCall.md): Represents a collaboration tool call between agents.

- [Codex.Items.CommandExecution](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.CommandExecution.md): Captures an execution request made by the agent, including aggregated output and
status metadata.

- [Codex.Items.Compaction](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.Compaction.md): Raw response item emitted when compaction summaries are generated.

- [Codex.Items.ContextCompaction](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.ContextCompaction.md): Marker item emitted when context compaction occurred.

- [Codex.Items.DynamicToolCall](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.DynamicToolCall.md): Metadata describing a dynamic tool invocation handled outside the static tool registry.

- [Codex.Items.Error](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.Error.md): Normalised error record describing failures surfaced during a turn.

- [Codex.Items.FileChange](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.FileChange.md): Represents a file diff emitted by the agent, including per-path change metadata and
completion status.

- [Codex.Items.GhostSnapshot](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.GhostSnapshot.md): Raw response item describing a ghost snapshot captured for undo.

- [Codex.Items.ImageGeneration](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.ImageGeneration.md): Image generation result item emitted by the app-server.

- [Codex.Items.ImageView](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.ImageView.md): An image view event emitted by the app-server when it renders a local image.

- [Codex.Items.McpToolCall](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.McpToolCall.md): Metadata describing a tool invocation routed through an MCP server.

- [Codex.Items.Plan](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.Plan.md): Planning item emitted when the agent publishes a plan as a first-class thread item.

- [Codex.Items.RawResponseItem](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.RawResponseItem.md): Fallback container for unparsed raw response items.

- [Codex.Items.Reasoning](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.Reasoning.md): Intermediate reasoning trace shared as part of tool or agent transparency.

- [Codex.Items.ReviewMode](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.ReviewMode.md): Indicates that review mode has been entered or exited.

- [Codex.Items.TodoList](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.TodoList.md): Structured checklist shared by the agent to track outstanding follow-up items.

- [Codex.Items.UserMessage](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.UserMessage.md): User-authored message item carrying a list of input blocks.

- [Codex.Items.WebSearch](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Items.WebSearch.md): Records a web search request issued by the agent, preserving the original query.

- [Codex.ModelSettings](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.ModelSettings.md): Model tuning options and provider selection used to configure codex runs.

- [Codex.Net.CA](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Net.CA.md): Shared custom CA bundle resolution for subprocesses and outbound TLS clients.
- [Codex.OAuth.Session](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.OAuth.Session.md): Internal OAuth session structs shared across flows and token stores.

- [Codex.OAuth.Session.PendingDeviceLogin](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.OAuth.Session.PendingDeviceLogin.md): Pending device-code OAuth login state returned by `Codex.OAuth.begin_login/1`.

- [Codex.OAuth.Session.PendingLogin](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.OAuth.Session.PendingLogin.md): Pending browser-based OAuth login state returned by `Codex.OAuth.begin_login/1`.

- [Codex.Plugins.Paths](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Plugins.Paths.md): Canonical local authoring paths for plugin manifests and marketplaces.

- [Codex.Protocol.ByteRange](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Protocol.ByteRange.md): Byte range for text element positioning.

- [Codex.Protocol.CollaborationMode](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Protocol.CollaborationMode.md): Collaboration mode configuration with presets.
- [Codex.Protocol.ConfigTypes](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Protocol.ConfigTypes.md): Protocol configuration type enums and converters.

- [Codex.Protocol.Elicitation](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Protocol.Elicitation.md): MCP elicitation request and action types.

- [Codex.Protocol.Elicitation.Request](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Protocol.Elicitation.Request.md): MCP elicitation request
- [Codex.Protocol.Ops](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Protocol.Ops.md): Encoders for Codex protocol operations submitted to the runtime.

- [Codex.Protocol.Plugin](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Protocol.Plugin.md): Typed app-server plugin request and response models.

  - [Codex.Realtime.Items](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Realtime.Items.md): Conversation item types for realtime sessions.
  - [Codex.Realtime.Model](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Realtime.Model.md): Behaviour for realtime model implementations.
  - [Codex.Realtime.ModelEvents](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Realtime.ModelEvents.md): Low-level events from the realtime model transport layer.
  - [Codex.Realtime.ModelInputs](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Realtime.ModelInputs.md): Input message types for sending events to the realtime model.
  - [Codex.Realtime.OpenAIWebSocket](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Realtime.OpenAIWebSocket.md): WebSocket client for OpenAI Realtime API.
  - [Codex.Realtime.PlaybackTracker](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Realtime.PlaybackTracker.md): Tracks audio playback progress for handling interruptions.
  - [Codex.Realtime.Runner](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Realtime.Runner.md): Orchestrates realtime agent sessions.
  - [Codex.Realtime.Session](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Realtime.Session.md): Manages a realtime session with WebSocket connection.

- Voice
  - [Codex.Voice](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.md): Voice pipeline for speech-to-speech AI interactions.
  - [Codex.Voice.AgentWorkflow](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.AgentWorkflow.md): A workflow that wraps a Codex.Agent for voice interactions.
  - [Codex.Voice.Config](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Config.md): Configuration for voice pipelines.
  - [Codex.Voice.Config.STTSettings](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Config.STTSettings.md): Settings for speech-to-text models.
  - [Codex.Voice.Config.TTSSettings](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Config.TTSSettings.md): Settings for text-to-speech models.
  - [Codex.Voice.Events](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Events.md): Voice stream event types for the voice pipeline.
  - [Codex.Voice.Input](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Input.md): Audio input types for voice pipelines.
  - [Codex.Voice.Input.AudioInput](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Input.AudioInput.md): A single, complete audio input buffer.
  - [Codex.Voice.Input.StreamedAudioInput](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Input.StreamedAudioInput.md): A streaming audio input that can be appended to.
  - [Codex.Voice.Model](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Model.md): Behaviours for speech-to-text and text-to-speech models.
  - [Codex.Voice.Models.OpenAIProvider](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Models.OpenAIProvider.md): OpenAI voice model provider.
  - [Codex.Voice.Models.OpenAISTT](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Models.OpenAISTT.md): OpenAI speech-to-text model implementation.
  - [Codex.Voice.Models.OpenAITTS](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Models.OpenAITTS.md): OpenAI text-to-speech model implementation.
  - [Codex.Voice.Pipeline](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Pipeline.md): Orchestrates STT → Workflow → TTS voice pipelines.
  - [Codex.Voice.Result](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Result.md): Streamed audio result from a voice pipeline.
  - [Codex.Voice.SimpleWorkflow](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.SimpleWorkflow.md): A simple workflow that uses a function to process transcriptions.
  - [Codex.Voice.Workflow](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.Voice.Workflow.md): Behaviour for voice workflows.

- Exceptions
  - [Codex.GuardrailError](https://codex-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Codex.GuardrailError.md): Error raised when a guardrail rejects or trips during execution.
